Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as molecule_chembl_id, molecule name as molecule_name, max phase as max_phase, molecule type as molecule_type, and canonical SMILES as canonical_smiles for compounds in document CHEMBL4818987. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4818987. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
